# ADR-3050: A05: Default admin password setting for appliance 2

## Status

Accepted

## Context

Normative language in the Decision section follows RFC 2119 (Bradner, S., "Key words for use in RFCs to Indicate Requirement Levels", BCP 14, March 1997).

Default credentials are publicly known.

## Decision

Platform images SHALL rotate any default admin password setting for appliance 2 (A05-2).

## Consequences

First-boot forces unique secrets.
